There is a lookout spot with a seat about half-way up the hill.
Continue several minutes to the lookout point.
The track starts from the Lake Matheson carpark.

doubts: The start is the Lake Matheson carpark, placed at F1 (where the Lake Matheson Walk meets Lake Matheson Road). The end is the lookout point, which has no feature; ref T4 (Lake Gault) is used because the page places the lookout on Lake Gault ('reflected on the surface of Lake Gault'). The branch-off point from the Lake Matheson walk is not named. 'Anti-clockwise' refers to the Lake Matheson walk followed on the way out, not to this out-and-back walk, so direction is null. Time and distance are DOC's summary for the way. Out and back is from DOC's 'return via same track' distance and the 'return' time.
